indicators: Inputs (source declarations): len1 = input(21, minval=1); len2 = input(55, minval=1); len3 = input(200, minval=1); len4 = input(233, minval=1); Periods = input(title="ATR Period", type=input.integer, defval=10); src = input(hl2, title="Source"); Multiplier = input(title="ATR Multiplier", type=input.float, step=0.1, defval=3.0); changeATR= input(title="Change ATR Calculation Method ?", type=input.bool, defval=true); showsignals = input(title="Show Buy/Sell Signals ?", type=input.bool, defval=true); highlighting = input(title="Highlighter On/Off ?", type=input.bool, defval=true) | Indicator calls: EMA (EMA 1); EMA (EMA 2); ema(close, length); ema(ema1, length); ema(ema2, length); ema(close, 20); ema(close, 50); ema(close, 100); ema(close, 200); ema(close,len1); ema(close,len2); ema(close,len3); ema(close,len4); sma(tr, Periods); atr(Periods)
entry_long: Source rule: time is at least  start
exit: Source rule: time is at least  start; order: strategy.close("long",when=Exitlong)
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Third-party Pine source; verify execution timing, pyramiding, and broker-emulator semantics before implementation.
